transcript: That lifeboat's beacon is our only chance of getting reunited with the rest of the crew. We have to stay with it. You mean this? We need to move up to the second level and use that control to open the shuttle bay door. This is it. Halo's control center. Cortana to Echo 419. Break off. The door is closed. Stay on station and we'll call in when we get the door open.
Cortana to Echo 419! Come in Echo 419! Cortana to Echo 419. Foehammer, relay the evac order.
We weren't able to save any marines from that lifeboat. Cortana to Echo 419.
Cortana to Echo 419! Request extraction now! On the double!
Cortana to Echo 419, requesting reinforcements at our position. Cortana to Echo 419.
Cortana to Echo 419. The Chief and I are topside, requesting pickup.
Cortana to Echo 419! Two Covenant Banshees are approaching on your six! Evade! Say again, evade! Cortana to Echo 419. We have the Captain and need extraction on the double. Cortana to Fauxhammer.
